fields.notes: Neither IHI 0033C (AHB) nor IHI 0024C (APB) specifies DFT / scan / BIST / MBIST / boundary scan. The protocols only specify functional signaling. Concrete AHB / APB Manager / Subordinate / bridge IPs add standard scan insertion + DFT compression + boundary-scan during SoC integration; debug visibility is typically provided via ARM CoreSight, JTAG (IEEE 1149.1), and trace components - all outside the scope of these bus protocol specs.
fields.ahb5_parity_only_diagnostic: The closest protocol-defined fault-detection feature is AHB5's optional Interface protection using parity (Chapter 12 — HADDRCHK / HCTRLCHK / HWDATACHK / HRDATACHK / HRESPCHK / HREADYCHK). This is functional fault detection, not DFT.
